name: Senses
notes: Ways of perceiving the world the player can have. Seeded with the archer's tracking (mw-e19.4), which the Sleepers' Path (E25) reads to show sleepwalker trails in daylight; without it the trails show only at night.

capabilities.name: Tracking
capabilities.description: Read tracks, trampled grass and disturbed dust, and follow a trail by daylight.
